metadata.title: [Perf][SM70][DeepSeek-V4.1] Fast routed-expert decode kernels (VLLM_V41_EXPERT_FAST, default off)
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

**Depends on #1383.** This branch is #1383 (one commit), then one commit; review only the last commit. `gguf_v41_moe.py`'s fast path takes #1383's plan mode (`_PLAN_FUSE`). Our instruction-diet PR builds on this one.

## Purpose

New v41k kernels for the DeepSeek-V4.1 TP4 row-split routed experts at decode (M = 1..6), beside the old ones, selected by **`VLLM_V41_EXPERT_FAST=1`** (default off). The old kernels are not touched.

- `gate_up_fast` replaces `q8 + gate_up7` / `gate_up7p` (both plan modes); `down_rows_fast` replaces `down_rows` at row tile 4 (other tiles raise).
- Decode: every codebook entry is one 32-bit PRMT selector word, so an IQ2_XXS / IQ2_XS / IQ1_M octet is 1 LDS + 2 PRMT instead of a byte-codebook lookup plus `__vsub4` / `__vadd4` (emulated on sm_70, 4-5 instructions per word). The IQ2 tables are replicated across shared-memory banks (1-2 wavefronts per warp lookup instead of ~3.5).
- Numerics: bitwise identical to the old kernels: same per-lane serial chains, butterflies and accumulation order; only the assignment of rows and experts to warps and CTAs differs (empty classes add +0 to a total that starts at +0).
- `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/expert_fast_check.py`: one-GPU bit check, both roles, gtypes 29 / 16 / 17 (IQ1_M, IQ2_XXS, IQ2_XS), M = 1..6, both plan modes, whole output and plan buffers compared, NaN-prefilled outputs. `v41k/emu`: host emulator that checks the decoded int8 weights exhaustively against the old decode.
- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_expert_fast.py`: CPU dispatch tests (same launches in the same order, arguments, logging).

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check / ruff format --check   # ruff 0.14.0, changed .py files
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check   # and the other four 1Cat reference checks
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_expert_fast.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_plan_fuse.py
python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41k/build.py                                  # sm_70
python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/expert_fast_check.py --lib v41k.so --no-time   # one V100
```

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fast experts | GGUF IQ1_M / IQ2_XXS / IQ2_XS routed experts | SM70, TP4 row split, decode M <= 6, `VLLM_V41_EXPERT_FAST=1` | `gate_up_fast` + `down_rows_fast`; other row tiles raise | GPU bit check (one V100); CPU dispatch tests; measured on 8x V100 | other gtypes |
| Switch off | all | default | old kernels, unchanged | CPU dispatch tests | — |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: opt-in; `VLLM_V41_EXPERT_FAST` defaults off.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: `VLLM_V41_EXPERT_FAST=1` (with `VLLM_V41_PLAN_FUSE=1` as measured) and a `v41k.so` built from this tree.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: the #1277 packed-KV default.
- Wheel SHA or source commit: measured on our build of the #1277 merge (`899e9ed33`) with the PP2 x TP4 port and our other default-off levers; this branch is rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: `v41k.so` (this tree's `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41k`).
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: below; the route logs its activation once.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: unchanged; the old kernels are not touched.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no variable renamed or removed.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: variables registered with metadata; references pass.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: new variables registered, 0 unregistered reads.

## Test Result

**MEASURED, 2026-11-03,** 8x V100-SXM2-32GB, DeepSeek-V4.1 PP2 x TP4, DSpark 5, one request, paired ABBA arms, ms per round (two runs each): the down kernel **-0.68 / -0.84 at T=0, -0.62 / -0.63 at T=1**; the gate/up kernel a further **-0.82 / -0.53 at T=0, -0.64 / -0.58 at T=1**. Output texts identical. Long context with the full stack: 32K 28.84, 64K 30.05, 128K 32.80 ms per round, vs 29.51 / 30.73 / 33.62 without this switch.

**Re-run for this PR, 2026-11-05,** on this branch rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`:

- sm_70 build of `v41k.so` from this tree, then `expert_fast_check.py --no-time` on one V100-SXM2-32GB, both roles, gtypes 29 / 16 / 17, M = 1..6, both plan modes, 48 trials per M and mode: **0 failing trials** (0 differing bytes in hq / hd / past hd / plan; 0 differing own or other rows in down; no NaN in either kernel's output). The kernel sources of the build are identical to this branch's (the only later change is #1383's test file).

- pytest, the two files above, CPU only: 427 passed.
- the five 1Cat reference checks: all pass; ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check`: pass.

Not re-run: timing (the GPU check ran with `--no-time`), sanitizers and serving.

---
